Select canonical_smiles, chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units. Source: activities, assays, molecule_dictionary, compound_structures. Join: activities.assay_id = assays.assay_id, activities.molregno = molecule_dictionary.molregno, molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno. Filter: assays.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1054500', activities.standard_value IS NOT NULL, activities.standard_relation = '='. Sort: canonical_smiles ASC, chembl_id ASC, standard_type ASC, standard_relation ASC, standard_value ASC, standard_units ASC.
